template.name: Labouchere EA
template.entry_long: donchian_high(high,{p0}) - donchian_low(low,{p1}) > {p0} and crossabove({p1} * (close - donchian_low(low,{p2})) / (donchian_high(high,10) - donchian_low(low,10)), sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,10)) / (donchian_high(high,10) - donchian_low(low,10)), 190))
template.exit_long: donchian_high(high,10) - donchian_low(low,10) > 0 and crossbelow(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,10)) / (donchian_high(high,10) - donchian_low(low,10)), sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,10)) / (donchian_high(high,10) - donchian_low(low,10)), 190))
template.notes: Stochastic %K is expressed as the 10-bar close position and %D as its SMA(190), both documented, with an explicit non-zero range guard; the mirrored cross supplies a long exit. Labouchere lot sequencing, the work-time window, and the 40/50 price-step stop and target are not percent fields.
